page_title: NEW 2-0 NOT | Newcastle v Nottingham Forest 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Peter Bankes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 8:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90+2' Substitution. Joelinton did his best and is replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Nick Woltemade is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
87' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes.
84' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Matz Sels no chance!
83' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
83' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Peter Bankes ignores the protests.
82' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul. Penalty awarded! Newcastle will take a penalty kick.
81' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
79' What an amazing save by Nick Pope! Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
77' It will be a substitution. Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) is ready to enter the pitch as Morato walks off.
77' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Bruno Guimaraes, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
75' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) fires a rebound from close range onto the bar!
73' The resulting corner from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
73' The ball is crossed into the box and Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the top left corner, but Matz Sels gets a glove on it to thwart him.
73' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
72' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Newcastle.
70' Here is a change. Anthony Gordon is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Anthony Elanga as he is replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
69' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
68' Morato (Nottingham) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is replacing Dan Ndoye.
64' Here comes a substitution. Igor Jesus (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Chris Wood.
64' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) replacing Ryan Yates.
63' Newcastle control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
58' 1 - 0 Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
57' There's an opportunity for Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
56' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
56' Neco Williams (Nottingham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Nick Pope is alert and denies him.
55' PENALTY APPEAL after Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
53' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.

53' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
51' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will take a corner kick.

51' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Nottingham.
48' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd). Newcastle will take a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
40' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
36' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' The yellow card goes to Neco Williams (Nottingham).
32' The game is interrupted. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
32' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle will take a free kick near the side line.

31' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Newcastle are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
28' It looks like Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) saw red with that tackle. Peter Bankes won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Nottingham are awarded a free kick.
25' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Nottingham will take a free kick.
20' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
19' Nottingham have a free kick from a promising distance.
18' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece.

16' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) connects with an inch-perfect cross and from around the penalty spot he steers a header towards the left side of the goal, but Matz Sels pulls off a brilliant save and diverts the ball onto the post.
14' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the corner kick.
14' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

11' A sweet pass finds Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Matz Sels is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
10' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.

8' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
2' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes was nominated as the referee for this game.
